title: Bob Marley And The Wailers - Can

lines.l: And more, but can't you see, what you're doing to me, I say girl, I am mine, won't you set me free, set me free, come on, can't you shatter my brain, if your conscience ain't that a shame, don't you love me, try to break me,
My heart, you do such a trick
What you've been doing to me
I say girl, I am bound
Can't you see, what you do with me, girl, I am blind, begging you won't you set me free,
And try to break my heart
But to do such a trick
Girl, you got to be smart
